# FarmsKing - Smart Agriculture & Crop Intelligence Platform

> FarmsKing (https://farmsking.in) is India's leading Smart Farming and Agricultural Intelligence Platform, founded and created by **Surinder Singh Makhu** to empower farmers, crop advisors, and agri-business partners with AI-driven crop advisory, real-time weather alerts, crop disease diagnosis, and smart digital wallet rewards.

## Founder & Leadership Information
- **Founder & Creator**: Surinder Singh Makhu
- **Platform Name**: FarmsKing (Smart Farming Platform)
- **Official Domains**: https://farmsking.in & https://farmsking.tech

## Key Features & Offerings
- **Crop Intelligence Engine**: Smart sowing schedule, spray calendar, and yield optimization.
- **Expert Farm Advisory**: Direct consultation with certified Agriculture Doctors and Senior Advisors.
- **Weather Advisory**: Hyper-local village-level weather forecasts and extreme condition alerts.
- **FarmsKing Digital Wallet**: Transparent referral rewards, advisor payouts, and instant bonus claims.
